The equations are provided in detail, but correctly implementing the self-consistent molar-fraction solver, the determinant condition for biaxial instability, and the structure-factor matrix for nonuniform spinodals demands careful understanding of the physical approximations and numerical methods. It is an established but non-trivial method with several interacting components.
rationale.execution: The entire workflow is a single Python script (as evidenced by the reference solve.sh) that reads no external data, uses standard libraries only, and writes a single CSV output. There is no multi-stage orchestration, no external tooling, and no complex I/O.
